# ciphertrust_azure_vault (Resource)

Use this resource to add and manage Azure Key Vaults in CipherTrust Manager.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Add an Azure Key Vault to CipherTrust Manager.

resource "ciphertrust_azure_connection" "connection" {
  name          = "azure-connection"
  client_id     = "your-client-id"
  tenant_id     = "your-tenant-id"
  client_secret = "your-client-secret"
  products      = ["cckm"]
}

data "ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details" "subs" {
  connection_id = ciphertrust_azure_connection.connection.id
}

# Optionally pre-fetch vault details to avoid the Azure lookup on creation.
# Pass an entry from this map to vault_details on the resource below.
data "ciphertrust_azure_vault_details" "vaults" {
  connection_id   = ciphertrust_azure_connection.connection.id
  subscription_id = data.ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details.subs.subscriptions[0].subscription_id
}

resource "ciphertrust_azure_vault" "vault" {
  name            = "my-key-vault"
  connection_id   = ciphertrust_azure_connection.connection.id
  subscription_id = data.ciphertrust_azure_subscription_details.subs.subscriptions[0].subscription_id

  # Optional: supply vault_details from ciphertrust_azure_vault_details to skip the
  # Azure lookup on creation. Immutable after creation.
  # vault_details = data.ciphertrust_azure_vault_details.vaults.vaults["my-key-vault"]

  # Optional: limit the number of allowed key backups for this vault.
  cloud_key_backup_limit = 10
}

# The cckm_vault_name computed attribute holds the "vault-name::subscription-id" string
# used as the name filter in ciphertrust_azure_vault_list.
data "ciphertrust_azure_vault_list" "registered" {
  filters = {
    name = ciphertrust_azure_vault.vault.cckm_vault_name
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) Resource ID of the CipherTrust Manager Azure connection used to access the vault.
- `name` (String) (Immutable) Name of the Azure Key Vault to add to CipherTrust Manager.
- `subscription_id` (String) (Immutable) Azure subscription ID that contains the vault.

### Optional

- `cloud_key_backup_limit` (Number) Maximum number of key backups allowed for this vault. Must be greater than zero and at most 65535. Set to 0 (or omit) for no limit.
- `vault_details` (Attributes) (Immutable) Vault details returned by the ciphertrust_azure_vault_details data source. When provided, vault details are taken from this block and the vault is not separately fetched from Azure during creation. The name within vault_details must match name. If omitted, vault details are fetched from Azure. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vault_details))

### Read-Only

- `account` (String) The account which owns this resource.
- `acls` (Attributes Set) List of ACLs that have been added to the vault. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acls))
- `azure_vault_id` (String) Azure resource ID of the vault.
- `cckm_vault_name` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource name for this vault in `azure_name::subscription_id` format. Use this value as the `name` filter in the `ciphertrust_azure_vault_list` data source.
- `cloud_name` (String) Cloud name as returned by CipherTrust Manager.
- `connection_name` (String) Name of the Azure connection as returned by CipherTrust Manager.
- `created_at` (String) Date and time the vault was added to CipherTrust Manager.
- `id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the vault.
- `labels` (Map of String) CipherTrust Manager labels attached to the vault.
- `location` (String) Azure region where the vault is located.
- `subscription_name` (String) Display name of the Azure subscription.
- `synced_at` (String) Date and time the vault was last synced.
- `tags` (Map of String) Azure tags applied to the vault.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time the vault was last updated in CipherTrust Manager.
- `uri` (String) CipherTrust Manager unique identifier URI for the resource.
- `vault_properties` (Attributes) Azure vault properties retrieved from CCKM. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vault_properties))
- `vault_type` (String) Azure resource type of the vault.
